Axiom:
Scope names, types, and statuses come from the `sdd-state` snapshot already in context (its `[SCOPES]` section). Portal absent → no specs → HALT.
`specs/README.md` itself is read for the one thing that snapshot does not carry: the dependency edges A→B (from the Mermaid `graph TD` Scope Graph, or the Scopes table `depends-on` column).
The scaffold target set is the operator/session target plus its transitive `depends-on` closure from the portal graph and the scopes' declared module links. If the request targets the whole approved project or carries no narrower target, every ✅ scope from the same snapshot is the explicit bounded fallback. Typed diagnostics name missing/ambiguous evidence and its next owner.
Cascade computation requires full scope graph traversal: - **Traversed-scopes** for a target scope = all scopes reachable via `depends-on` edges (transitive closure). - **Cascade** = union of Effective Rules from traversed-scopes + target-scope rules + (module rules if product/library) + task additions.
| Scopes present | Result | |---|---| | Only infrastructure scopes | scaffold infra tasks only; no module trackers | | Mix of product/library + infra/contracts | full project; infra tasks = DAG roots | | No scopes at all | HALT: no spec input |
